visual_qa.identity: Broad bell roof with original star/navy bands, crown hanging yoke and side winding drum, a single large pear-shaped gold clapper and torn compass-star navy cloak remain recognizable.
visual_qa.transformation: Low broad predatory bell body, jaw-like hinged lower shell, larger forward-swinging clapper and substantially thickened ground-braced legs. No human or gargoyle head.
visual_qa.framing: Whole yoke, cloak ends, jaw plates, clapper and all ground tips contained; outer margins narrow but not cropped.
visual_qa.anatomy: Six articulated gold-tipped legs, three per side, are clear. Small central lower pointed fragment joins the navy shell edge without a joint or gold foot and reads as shell debris, not an extra articulated leg. One clapper, no human limbs. Root and independent visual review passed.
